title: Dyson Ontrac Headphones $219 (RRP $799) + Delivery ($0 to Select Areas) @ Woolworths Online
body:
Deal: Dyson Ontrac Headphones $219 (RRP $799) + Delivery ($0 to Select Areas) @ Woolworths Online

[SometimesStingy] Any ideas about the refund policy, seems a bit vague? I’d like to try these out with the option of returning if I’m not keen.
Thanks!
[Jimbo24] Seems to be standard 30 day change of mind returns policy. Requires item to be unopened.
You could purchase direct from Dyson and get 45day money back guarantee, see if they will price match?
[shroomish] Heavy, sound good. Still reach for my 1more sonoflow for half the price, less from alix.
[poppingtags] Sennheiser Momentum 4 also sounded better, while being lighter and more comfortable to wear.
[SometimesStingy] How about ANC? Specially for flights (maybe wind/traffic as a comparison)
[poppingtags] I've been pleased with the Momentum's noise cancelling, but reviews mentioned it wasn't as good as Sony, Bose and Apple's. Sound quality was more important to me than noise cancellation, and the Momentums deliver great value in that space!
[SometimesStingy] @poppingtags: Thank you! I currently have the momentum 4s too. I would pick these up if the noise cancellation is significantly better for long haul flights.
[PuppieWayne] If you don't stress about anc, fiio eh11.
Love the pair I got, cheap and sound quality is amazing!
[Jimbo24] Nil, but the Prussian Blue/Copper colour matches my Dyson Gen5Detect Complete Vacuum, which does have fantastic suction for a cordless.
[Jimbo24] Thats the most recent Sale price, they have taken an extra 20% off. plus use the code GET10 for $10 off purchases over $100. Dyson site lists RRP $799. IMO not worth the RRP, but they are great for this price. I paid $279 a few months ago
[Jimbo24] No, but for $219 I think these are great. I paid $279 a few months ago.
[adamreid] I have the 'zone' version of these with the silly fan, they sound better than my Airpods Max if you use the balanced EQ profile.
[Consumer123] I feel the same, zone air sound and noise cancelling both are better.
I've removed fans and replaced them with a $20 speaker grill, now like very sleek..
[spaceflight] Hopefully these are more reliable than the toothbrush
[Jimbo24] I hope so! They do feel very durable, and they were released over 2 years ago and doesn't seem to be many reliability issues reported online. My friend bought the new toothbrush, and no faults… yet! But probably won't be too far in the future lol
[kaybrr] Dyson is really rolling out the garbage these days with these and of course the recent faulty toothbrush
These Ontrac Headphones are On Track to the garbage bin.
[adamreid] How are they garbage? They sound really good and have insane battery life?
[JoeOz] Also on Kogan
https://www.kogan.com/au/buy/dyson-ontractm-headphones-cnc-a…
[parcus] Where’s the 30% cashback deals when you need it :(
[warwagon86] Have a pair of these that I got for a stupid cheap price a while back on here. Look the sound is good and I like it. I'm a big headed lump of coal so they are ok on me but they are bloody heavy and absolutely useless for the gym.
Originally bought for the boss but she laughed and said it was like putting an anvil on her head.
[ozbozb123] Is this the one with the covid-dated air purifier for your face?
[Jimbo24] No, that was the Dyson Zone Purifying Headphones. Think that was an ozbargain deal for $99 way back. I believe the sound engineering is similar to these, just without the purifier contraption
[kaybrr] I remember seeing a fart test on youtube where they put a guy in a room with 10 farters. The headphones didn't stand a chance.
[George Washington] Any bluetooth connection with the toothbrush? i want to hear my teeth get cleaned
[Manny Calavera] How am I supposed to listen to clean music when I still have to breathe dirty air?
[Count Shagula] Compared to what headphones for 219au dollary doo's?
